data.status: aiming to open in late 2026 before the holidays
data.short_description: Under Pressure Wine Bar is a new concept from sommelier Juan Fernando Cortés and Adam Berlin, planned for 4920 Roswell Road in North Buckhead at Fountain Oaks. The concept flips traditional wine pairing by selecting wines first and building complementary dishes around them, anchored by a 1,500+ bottle cellar.

SHARIGATO, Charlotte's first dedicated hand roll restaurant, is opening on May 19, 2026 at Joinery, founded by Chef Shari Robins with over 20 years of culinary experience. The menu features hand rolls with toro, salmon, yellowtail, scallops, and lobster, along with Japanese-inspired snacks, cocktails, sake, and beer.

data.location: 24214 Jefferson Ave, St Clair Shores, MI 48080
data.short_description: Joe Vicari Restaurant Group has officially taken over operations for Hook at 24214 Jefferson Avenue in St. Clair Shores, with the change announced on May 8. A new menu crafted by Executive Chef Jim Oppat will celebrate Great Lakes seafood, prime steaks, and seasonal starters, with more investments in the restaurant to follow.

data.location: 968-12 S Westlake Blvd, Westlake Village, CA 91361
data.short_description: CAVA is opening a new location at 968-12 S Westlake Boulevard in Westlake Village on May 15, 2026, open daily from 10:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. Ahead of the grand opening, CAVA will host a Community Day offering free meals and matching donations up to $1,000 to Food Share of Ventura County, with the location expected to create 25 to 40 local jobs.

Bar Susanne is opening at 6 River Street in Williamsburg on May 15, 2026, featuring a seafood-focused menu and raw bar program led by Executive Chef Jackie Carnesi, with seafood sourced from Long Island's North Fork. The 75-seat coastal-inspired space was created by James Beard Award-nominated designer Matthew Maddy and partner Marisa Maddy Ripo.

Panda Express is opening at 5 District Ave in Dorchester on May 15, 2026, marking the brand's first Boston-area location in eight years, with seating for 59 guests and approximately 40 local jobs expected. A $5,000 donation to the Boys & Girls Club of Dorchester is planned for opening day, and the first 88 guests will receive a free t-shirt.

data.location: 267 N El Camino Real, Suite A, Encinitas, CA 92024
data.status: expected to open later this year
data.short_description: The Stand is planned for 267 El Camino Real, Suite A in Encinitas, per filings with the Department of Environmental Health and Quality, marking the chain's fourth San Diego County location. An exact opening date has not yet been determined, as the company is currently focused on its mid-August opening in Mission Valley Mall.

data.location: 3930 S Las Vegas Blvd, Ste 116, Las Vegas, NV 89119
data.short_description: Iris Galerie is expected to open in The Shoppes At Mandalay Place at 3930 S Las Vegas Blvd, Ste 116, per a City of Las Vegas permit, confirmed by Tanguy Saillant. The Paris-born brand specializes in high-resolution customized iris photography, capturing and printing personalized artwork of customers' eyes.

data.location: 5000 Ashley Phosphate Rd., North Charleston, SC 29418
data.status: currently undergoing renovations ahead of its new debut this summer
data.short_description: Frankie's Fun Park at 5000 Ashley Phosphate Road is currently undergoing renovations including a complete overhaul with state-of-the-art lighting, an updated game layout, and kitchen and dining area upgrades. New attractions including laser tag, bumper cars, and indoor thrill rides will be added, though an official reopening date has not yet been announced.

data.location: Near Meijer on U.S. 223, Adrian, MI
data.status: opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Brew Horizons, a franchise group of 7 Brew, plans to build a new coffee drive-through near the Meijer grocery store on U.S. 223 in Adrian, which would be the first 7 Brew location in Lenawee County. The project was recently approved by the city planning commission and an exact address has not yet been released.

Uptown Taco in Floral Park permanently closed on May 10, 2026, after the owners announced they had sold the restaurant. Founded in 2020 during the pandemic by Bill and Lou, the Mexican restaurant was known for tacos and a relaxed beach-style atmosphere.

data.status: hoping to debut in about six weeks
data.short_description: Chez Poulet, a new rotisserie chicken carry-out concept from Nicolas and Oliver Poilevey, is planned for 2234 N Western Avenue in Bucktown, replacing the former Taqueria Chingon space. The mostly carry-out spot will serve rotisserie chicken dishes and bread from Mindy's Bakery, with a wine shop opening in the back.

The Celia Jacobs Cheesecake Experience, a dessert trailer operating out of Thicket Food Park at 7800 South 1st Street in South Austin, will permanently close on May 31, 2026, after 13 years in business. Owners Phyllis and Kimmie shared the announcement on social media, citing no specific reason for the closure.

data.status: final day of dinner service at West Village will be June 7
data.short_description: Marrow Detroit announced the closure of its West Village location at 8044 Kercheval Avenue, with its final dinner service on June 7, 2026. Founder Ping Ho stated the company will focus on growth at its Eastern Market location and Marrow Detroit Provisions.

data.status: will run through Memorial Day weekend
data.short_description: The Birmingham location of Marrow will close after Memorial Day weekend, after which it will pivot to a new concept where Marrow will still have a presence. Further details on the transition were not provided at time of publication.

data.location: 5485 Camino Al Norte, North Las Vegas, NV 89135
data.short_description: Zippy's Restaurants is opening its fifth Las Vegas location at Camino Al Norte in North Las Vegas on May 19, 2026, with a grand opening event planned. The location will feature the brand's first prepaid order pickup lane in the Las Vegas market, offering Hawaiian comfort food including the Zip Pac and signature chili.

data.status: reopening for dine-in services on May 14, 2026
data.short_description: Calypso Cafe is reopening its Charlotte Avenue location for full dine-in service on May 14, 2026, after operating primarily as a prep and catering kitchen during and after the pandemic. The refreshed space features indoor seating for 70 guests, an outdoor patio, and plans to add bar service with local draft and craft beers in coming weeks.

data.location: 2121 E Sahara Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89104
data.short_description: The Alaskan Fish Spot is a new food truck permitted to operate out of 2121 E Sahara Ave, with owner Lechaun Baker planning to open this spring in front of the Fantastic Indoor Swap Meet at 1717 S Decatur Blvd. No menu has been released yet and the brand has a social media page but no website.

data.status: expected to be open by next Spring
data.short_description: Carrabba's Italian Grill is planning a $2.75 million ground-up restaurant at 13215 N. Grand Parkway W in The Grand at 249 Shopping Center in Tomball, per a Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation permit. Construction is slated to begin in June 2026 and wrap up in March 2027, marking the first Carrabba's location in Tomball.

Daily Press Cafe is a new newsroom-themed cafe concept opening at 22001 Michigan Avenue, Suite 150 in downtown West Dearborn, replacing the former Kung Fu Tea location. Owner Mohamad Alshormany is aiming for an Aug. 1 opening, with a menu of coffees, teas, smoothies, and deli sandwiches.

Blank Street is set to open a second Philadelphia location at 1801 Spruce St. in the former Starbucks space, following its announced debut on the University of Pennsylvania campus. Both Philadelphia locations are expected to open this summer.

J Tap Kitchen is preparing to open at 3397 Summer Avenue, spanning 4,000 square feet with an occupant load of 99, per a certificate of occupancy from the Memphis and Shelby County Division of Planning and Development. The restaurant describes itself as an intimate culinary experience using seasonal ingredients, offering salads, sandwiches, seafood entrees, and desserts, and is currently hiring for all positions.

Café Bastille is planning a new restaurant in Miami's MiMo District, confirmed on LinkedIn as "coming soon," with an exact address and opening date not yet announced. The location will feature a backyard garden and serve the brand's signature all-day brunch menu, marking its fifth restaurant.

data.status: actively searching for a second location; no projected opening timeline
data.short_description: Out There Coffee Roasters is actively searching for a second San Francisco location, confirmed by founder Erica Ash, though negotiations have not yet been finalized. The woman-founded specialty coffee company began as pop-ups in 2020 before opening its first brick-and-mortar café in 2024.

data.location: 3775 E El Camino Real, Santa Clara, CA 95051
data.status: opening timeline has not been confirmed
data.short_description: Chubby Cattle BBQ has announced plans for a Santa Clara location at 3775 E. El Camino Real, though an opening timeline has not been confirmed. The all-you-can-eat yakiniku concept features premium wagyu beef, interactive tabletop grilling, and technology-driven dining including robot servers and conveyor systems.

data.location: 1105 S California Blvd, Walnut Creek, CA 94596
data.short_description: Mixt is targeting a mid-July opening at 1105 S California Boulevard in Walnut Creek, offering indoor and patio seating along with pickup and delivery through the Mixt app. The location will launch with MIXT's summer menu featuring returning favorites and a new Valkyries 2.0 salad, along with a custom art installation from a local artist.

data.location: 7300 Great Park Blvd, Suite A, Irvine, CA 92618
data.short_description: Osen Hospitality Group, led by Damon Cho, is set to open Osen Urban Table at 7300 Great Park Blvd., Suite A in Irvine, per an active plan review filed with the Orange County Health Care Agency for a new restaurant construction under 2,000 square feet. The modern Japanese concept will offer sushi, sashimi, kushiyaki, and other Japanese-inspired plates at an approachable price point alongside cocktails, sake, beer, and wine.

data.location: 5181 W Charleston Blvd #120, Las Vegas, NV 89146
data.status: slated for completion soon, with a summer opening in mind
data.short_description: Le Umu, an authentic Samoan eatery, is opening a new location inside Charleston West Plaza at 5181 W Charleston Blvd 120, per a City of Las Vegas permit, with construction currently underway. The brand previously operated a Silverado Ranch location and is known for traditional Polynesian dishes including Laua Pisupo and Lamb Curry.

A California ABC license application lists "The Win~Dow and a Bar" as proposed for 237 W. Chapman Ave. in Orange, suggesting the brand may also offer beer, wine, and spirits at this location. Founded by Paul Hibler and Jeff Goodman, The Win~Dow is known for affordable smash burgers, fried chicken sandwiches, grain bowls, fries, and milkshakes across multiple Southern California locations.

Chef Michael Mina announced Neighborhood Test Kitchen will take over the former International Smoke space at 301 Mission St in San Francisco, hosting rotating restaurant concepts that change every four to six months. The first residency is expected to feature an American brasserie-style menu developed by Mina Group's culinary team.

data.location: 3965 Alton Pkwy, Suite A, Irvine, CA 92606
data.status: opening timeline not yet publicly announced
data.short_description: Bushfire Kitchen has submitted plans for a location at 3965 Alton Parkway, Suite A at the Westpark Plaza shopping center in Irvine, per an active filing with the Orange County Health Care Agency. The Southern California chain, founded in 2012, is known for "healthy comfort food" featuring grass-fed tri-tip, burgers, salads, bowls, sandwiches, and empanadas.

data.location: 211 S Las Vegas Blvd #100, Las Vegas, NV 89101
data.short_description: Shang Artisan Noodle is set to open in the Downtown Las Vegas area along Carson Avenue Restaurant Row at 211 S Las Vegas Blvd 100, per a City of Las Vegas permit, with an Instagram post from the brand indicating a spring opening. The brand, founded in 2016 by Shudong Huang, specializes in handmade, hand-pulled, and knife-shaved noodles rooted in Shan-Xi province traditions.

data.status: anticipated to open by this fall
data.short_description: Arwa Coffee is expected to open at Gosling Plaza III at 21940 Gosling Rd, per a recently filed permit, with construction slated to start in mid-July and wrap up at the end of September. The Yemeni coffee brand, founded in 2022 in Richardson, Texas, also has a second Greater Houston location planned at 9719 Westheimer Road for fall 2026.

data.status: currently under construction and slated for a soft opening in the early fall
data.short_description: JB's Eatery, a Euro-Asian bistro from Huaibing "Bing" Zhang and chef John Liang, is currently under construction at 51 W 8th St. in the West Village, with a soft opening planned for early fall. The 20-seat restaurant will blend classical French and Italian techniques with bold Asian flavor profiles, with a signature dry-aged Peking-inspired duck as its centerpiece dish.

data.location: 4000 Arlington Highlands Blvd, Suite 133, Arlington, TX 76018
data.status: work expected to begin later this summer and conclude by end of year
data.short_description: Kura Revolving Sushi Bar is planning a new location at 4000 Arlington Highlands Blvd., Suite 133 in Arlington, per public filings, with construction expected to start later this summer and conclude by year-end. The chain, founded in Japan, combines traditional sushi dining with conveyor belt and touchscreen ordering technology and currently operates 16 locations in North Texas.

data.status: expected to relocate during the fourth quarter of 2026
data.short_description: Fà-me Café is expected to relocate from its longtime home at 4700 N. Central Ave. to a 3,600-square-foot ground-floor space at the 24th at Camelback office complex at 2375 E. Camelback Road in Phoenix's Biltmore neighborhood during Q4 2026. The locally owned breakfast and lunch restaurant was founded by Maria and Ivan O'Farrill and is known for brunch, coffee, and locally sourced ingredients.

Matilde, an elevated coastal Mexican concept from Next Level Brands' founder Jeff Gigante, is planned for the Arts and Entertainment Residences at 300 W Tyler St in Downtown Tampa, just off the Riverwalk. The restaurant is expected to open in Spring 2027.

data.status: expected to launch in late June/early July
data.short_description: 4T's Eatery, a relaunch of the former Phoenix Eatery by co-owner Torrey Jones and three family members, is expected to open in late June or early July at a larger, upgraded space at 6050 Moncrief Road in Jacksonville. The family-run restaurant is known for waffles and chicken-and-waffle combinations.

Norikawa, a new Japanese omakase restaurant from Pearl Hospitality Group, is in permit review for the One Riverside development at 1 Riverside Ave in Jacksonville's Brooklyn neighborhood. The two-floor space will feature indoor and outdoor bar and dining on the first floor, and a bar, lounge, outdoor dining, DJ booth, and omakase counter on the second floor.

data.location: 35246 Leesburg Pike, Suite 190, Round Hill, VA 20141
data.status: preparing to launch later this summer
data.short_description: OH's Wine Salon, from Ana Hirsbrunner and Waldemar Ortiz of OH's Vineyard, is preparing to open later this summer at 35246 Leesburg Pike, Suite 190 in Round Hill, Virginia. The 2,200-square-foot space will seat up to 45 guests, feature a scenic outdoor patio with a pond view, and offer Virginia wines alongside a small plates menu inspired by Nuevo Latino cuisine.

data.status: working to open by the end of the month
data.short_description: O'Mara Irish Pub, a veteran- and woman-owned Irish pub co-owned by Amy Tomb, is working to open by the end of June at 939 Edgewood Ave S in Jacksonville's Murray Hill neighborhood. The 100-seat venue will offer beer, wine, pub fare, live music, and open-mic jam nights, with plans to add Irish food items once open.
Fast-casual taquería La Neta is opening its second location in downtown Boston. The new space will share a footprint with Churrería 52, a new churro-focused concept from the same restaurateur.

Churrería 52 is a new churro-focused concept from restaurateur Allan Rodríguez, set to share a footprint with La Neta's second location in downtown Boston. The brand appears to specialize in churros in inventive forms and flavors.

Arcade Time Entertainment is expanding its Wellington location to include a food and drink menu featuring elevated dishes such as filet mignon and ahi tuna bowl. The arcade already offers modern and retro games, VR, duckpin bowling, and interactive darts.

data.status: hoping to be open by July 1 at the latest
data.short_description: Johnson's Coffee Co., a mobile coffee and matcha trailer, is opening its first permanent brick-and-mortar cafe at 1480 E Michigan Street in Orlando. The new space will expand the menu to include drip coffee and food items like avocado toast, bagels, and pastries.

data.status: looking to open in the middle or at the end of July
data.short_description: Bosu Latin Asian Fusion is the first standalone restaurant from the Bosu Asian Fusion Bistro brand, opening in Downtown Kissimmee. The restaurant will feature Puerto Rican, Japanese-Peruvian, and Chinese cuisine including ceviche, fried rice, and sushi, with an open kitchen concept.

A new Vietnamese restaurant called Mama Oi is opening at 400 N Cocoa Blvd in Cocoa, FL, a space that has previously housed multiple Vietnamese restaurants including Mamasan's, Papasan's, and Pho Lam's. Plan review documents were submitted by Mama Oi Vietnamese Kitchen LLC, but additional details were not yet available at time of publication.

Frutella, a Colombian-inspired restaurant with existing locations in Kissimmee and Riverview, appears to be opening a third location at 1333 Florida Mall Ave in Orlando. Plan review documents were submitted by Frutella Orlando LLC for the space formerly occupied by Could 07 Smoke Shop.

data.location: 241 Rue Morin, Chicoutimi, QC G7H 4X8, Canada
data.short_description: Hôtel du Fjord, a 34-room hotel in downtown Chicoutimi, has been sold to a new ownership group behind Auberge Le Parasol and Refuge du Fjord. The new owners plan to reposition the property toward a vacation-oriented, family-friendly concept while pursuing longer-term mixed-use development on adjacent land.

data.status: expected by the end of the month
data.short_description: Pienezza Pizza is opening a second location at 422 Terry Ave in Orlando, expanding from its existing Kissimmee location. The restaurant is known for handcrafted New York-style and Sicilian pizzas made with fresh ingredients.

Cipresso, the long-standing Italian restaurant at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Hollywood, is permanently closing on June 13, 2026. The space will be taken over by a new dining concept from Major Food Group, expected to open in Fall 2026.

An unnamed new dining concept from Major Food Group is set to debut at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Hollywood, replacing the property's existing Italian restaurant Cipresso. Details about the name and concept have not yet been released.

data.status: expected to open between mid and late August
data.short_description: Turquoise Wine Bar is preparing to open a franchise location at 14462 W. Elm Street, Suite 113 in Surprise City Center. The concept focuses on small-lot wines, small plates, live entertainment, and member experiences designed to be approachable rather than pretentious.

data.location: 1180 Rue King E, Sherbrooke, QC J1G 1E4, Canada
data.status: reopening delayed past October, new target set for late 2026
data.short_description: Chez Stanley restaurant-bar in Sherbrooke is undergoing a full rebuild after an accidental kitchen fire in September 2025 caused extensive smoke and water damage. The rebuilt restaurant will be larger than before, featuring a second floor, redesigned bar area, and improved live music space.

data.status: hoping to welcome guests in late July
data.short_description: Bravado is a new restaurant from Pop Hospitality Group opening at 1770 Galleria Boulevard in Franklin, in the former home of The Honeysuckle. Few details about the concept have been publicly released.

Joe and The Juice is opening a location at Union Station in Washington, DC, in a space previously occupied by Corner Bakery and Le Pain Quotidien. Signage is up and construction is underway, though a clear opening timeline has not been confirmed.

data.store_name: Rebelle (scoop shop at Épicerie Saveur urbaine)
data.short_description: Rebelle, a new ice cream brand from Laiterie de l'Outaouais, launched its first scoop shop at Épicerie Saveur urbaine in downtown Hull, Gatineau on May 21. The brand debuted with four flavours: iced cappuccino, funky, chocolate, and vanilla.

data.status: expected to open within three weeks
data.short_description: A second Rebelle scoop shop is planned within La Buena breakfast restaurant at 1160 boulevard Saint-Joseph in Gatineau's Hull sector. The expansion follows the retail launch of Rebelle ice cream on June 1 across the Outaouais and Ottawa regions.

data.location: 1125 SW Harvey Milk St, Portland, OR 97205
data.short_description: Camp Bar is preparing to open at 1125 SW Harvey Milk Street in downtown Portland, taking over the former Scandals space. The concept is partly owned by Logan Whalen and is planned to offer live music, DJ music, and karaoke in time for Pride season.

data.location: 25 The West Mall, Etobicoke, ON M9C 1B8, Canada
data.short_description: T&T Supermarket is set to open a new approximately 40,000 sq. ft. store at CF Sherway Gardens in Etobicoke, taking over the space previously occupied by Pusateri's Fine Foods. The store will feature fresh produce, live seafood, bakery items, ready-to-eat meals, sushi, and an Asian beauty section, creating approximately 120 jobs.

data.location: 11331 W Broad St, Suite 125, Glen Allen, VA 23060
data.short_description: Kura Revolving Sushi is opening a location at 11331 W Broad Street, Suite 125 in Glen Allen, VA, as part of the Short Pump Station shopping center. The restaurant's website says "coming soon" and a representative stated they're hopeful the restaurant will be ready in the fall.

data.location: 2112 N Clybourn Ave, Suite A, Chicago, IL 60614
data.short_description: A Buffalo Wild Wings GO takeout-focused location is opening at 2112 N Clybourn Avenue, Suite A in Lincoln Park, replacing the existing dine-in Buffalo Wild Wings nearby. The franchisee is relocating to a smaller space to align with the company's takeout-focused direction.

Gillis Family Tavern is relocating from its longtime home at the historic Jenny Grist Mill to the former site of Proof 22 at 22 Main Street in downtown Plymouth. The move to a larger space is intended to ease longstanding space constraints, with an official opening date not yet announced.

data.status: final day of service was May 31, 2026
data.short_description: Gillis Family Tavern closed its longtime location at the historic Jenny Grist Mill at 6 Spring Lane as of May 31, 2026, as part of its relocation to downtown Plymouth. The tavern is known for New England comfort food including clam chowder, fish and chips, and prime rib.

data.location: 18 Clayfield Commons, Niagara-on-the-Lake, ON L0S 1J0, Canada
data.status: set to open in late August 2026
data.short_description: Terrain is a new restaurant operated by Toronto's Ascari Group, set to open at The Clayfield Hotel in Niagara-on-the-Lake in late August 2026. Chef Joel LaBute will lead the kitchen, offering wine country cuisine inspired by Niagara's wineries, growers, and cultivators.

data.location: 100 City Centre Dr, Mississauga, ON L5B 2G6, Canada
data.status: exact opening date has yet to be announced
data.short_description: PAI Northern Thai Kitchen, a Michelin-recommended restaurant led by Chef Nuit Regular and Jeff Regular, is planning a new location at Square One Shopping Centre at 100 City Centre Dr in Mississauga, per an Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario listing. The filing indicates the restaurant will feature both indoor and outdoor dining areas, with the menu focused on Northern Thai cuisine including dishes like Khao Soi and Kanom Jin Nam Ngiao.

data.location: 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada
data.short_description: Figo, an Italian restaurant in Toronto's Entertainment District, permanently closed in early 2026 after nearly a decade of operation, according to BlogTO. The space, owned by Ink Entertainment, had previously shut down briefly in 2023 following a fire before reopening and later closing permanently.

data.location: 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada
data.status: expected to open later this summer
data.short_description: Bar Romy, a new Italian-focused restaurant, is preparing to open at 295 Adelaide Street West in Toronto, moving into the former Figo space owned by Ink Entertainment. An exact opening date has not been confirmed, and early visuals suggest a focus on approachable Italian staples, though no full menu or design plans have been publicly confirmed.

data.location: Steps from Gage Park, Hamilton's east end
data.short_description: Dear Grain Bakery, a Toronto-based sourdough and pastry brand, is expanding to Hamilton's east end near Gage Park, with co-founder Adri Greenspan confirming the production bakery is expected to open in fall 2026. The brand is known for naturally leavened sourdough made with locally sourced organic and heirloom grains, slow fermentation, and scratch-made pastries.

data.location: Steps from Gage Park, Hamilton's east end
data.short_description: Dear Grain Bakery's Hamilton storefront, a separate phase from the production bakery, is expected to open in early 2027 per co-founder Adri Greenspan. No exact address was provided in the article.

data.status: targeting a launch at the end of this month or early next month (June/July 2026)
data.short_description: Chimac is opening its third Greater Houston location at 10852 Westheimer Rd in the Lakeside Village Shopping Center in Westchase, with construction currently underway and final health department inspections in progress. Owners Daniel and Andrew Kim confirmed the opening is slated for June/July 2026, with the Korean-American fusion eatery known for scratch-made chicken wings and loaded bowls.
